items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary_en: /mvanhorn/last30days-skill is an AI agent skill that parallel-searches Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, Polymarket, HN, and the web to synthesize a grounded summary of any topic from the last 30 days. It scores content by upvotes, likes, and real-money engagement rather than editorial curation, bridging multiple walled-garden platforms that no single AI or search engine natively accesses. Users install via Claude Code marketplace or npx, with zero config for Reddit/HN/GitHub and quick setup wizard for additional sources like X and YouTube.

items.title: SQLite Critical CVEs or LLM Slop?
items.summary_en: A GitHub repo published dozens of SQLite CVE advisories that NVD and CISA initially flagged as critical, but JFrog researchers exposed them as AI-generated fabrications: cited code didn't exist in the referenced versions, PoC payloads failed to trigger crashes, and SQLite's official advisory page lists none of them. CVE-2026-51302 was downgraded from a 10.0 to a 7.6 severity score after verification revealed the alleged vulnerability mechanics were impossible by design. The researchers' isolated testing workflow—cloning official source tags, building in Docker, running PoCs under AddressSanitizer, and auditing NVD/GHSA metadata—confirmed the advisories were unreliable.

items.title: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
items.summary_en: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub that transforms conversations, documents, and code into four reusable assets: Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, and Code-Graph. Deployed via `start-all.sh` with three core services (memory-core, memory-hub, proxy) and managed through a web panel at localhost:8125, it enables automatic extraction, cross-framework portability, and cold-start onboarding for AI Agent teams.

items.title: Claude Code 连接器可复用至 Artifacts
items.summary: 将 Claude Connector（如 Gmail、日历、Slack 等）连接到 Claude 后，Claude Code 会自动继承这些连接，无需单独配置。这意味着在 Claude Code 中编写代码或运行 Artifacts 时，可以直接访问邮件、日历等服务，实现自动化操作。
items.summary_en: Claude Code inherits any Claude Connectors you've set up—such as Gmail, Calendar, and Slack—allowing direct access to these services within code operations and Artifacts. Many users only connect connectors to the Claude interface, unaware that Claude Code automatically carries those same integrations forward. This means configured services become immediately available when generating code or working in Artifacts without additional setup.

items.title: Cloudflare 推出 @cloudflare/computer 预览版：为智能体提供虚拟文件系统与多执行环境
items.summary: Cloudflare 推出 @cloudflare/computer 预览版，为智能体提供基于 SQLite 的持久化虚拟文件系统，支持 isolate 隔离环境（通过 just-bash 在动态 worker 中运行）与容器沙箱两种执行后端，两者作用于同一文件系统并自动同步。该方案将智能体使用容器的比例控制在 10% 以下，通过 Durable Object 实现无限水平扩展，相比传统为每个智能体分配独立容器的方案大幅优化性能与成本。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare has launched an early preview of the open-source **@cloudflare/computer** package, providing AI agents with a persistent SQLite-backed virtual filesystem and multiple execution backends. Agents can seamlessly operate across two environments — a fast, cost-efficient **isolate runtime** (using just-bash translated to JavaScript in dynamic Workers) and a full **Linux container runtime** via Cloudflare Containers mounted through FUSE — with all file changes syncing across both. Built with AI SDK compatibility, the package exposes read, write, edit, ls, and exec tools, enabling intelligent agents to select the appropriate backend per task; Cloudflare's goal is for container usage to drop below 10%, with isolate environments handling coding, document creation, and media processing.

items.title: 可灵观察②｜用可灵重现《霸王别姬》：电影感足了，复杂叙事如何更稳？
items.summary: 本文使用可灵3.0的首尾帧图生视频与主体绑定功能，围绕《霸王别姬·前世今生》脚本进行短片创作压力测试。结果显示，可灵3.0在构图、光影氛围和人物主体一致性方面表现突出，适合单目标短镜头的高质感画面生成；复杂叙事需通过分镜拆解工作流实现，即将长动作拆分为单镜头任务后剪辑串联。测试结论为复杂交互场景的产出确定性低于单目标短镜头。
items.summary_en: Keling 3.0 is an AI video generation model that excels at producing cinematic-quality key shots with strong composition, atmospheric lighting, and stable character consistency, particularly for short, single-action sequences. For complex narratives involving multi-prop combat or cross-space movement, the model requires a拆解 (breakdown) workflow where long scenes are split into individual short shots and reassembled through editing. The model's core strength lies in key frame generation rather than handling extended, information-dense continuous action.

items.title: OpenAI's super PAC is funding AI-generated news site attacking industry critics
items.summary_en: OpenAI's super PAC is funding Targeted Victory's political operation, which appears to operate Acutus, an anonymously run AI-generated news site. Launched December 29, 2025, Acutus published 94 articles in under four months, with 69% flagged as fully AI-generated and 28% partially AI-generated by content detectors. Technical analysis reveals a React-based editorial interface where stories are produced using "AI Background Context" and "Question Prompts" fields rather than human reporters.

items.title: 韩国散户情绪低迷，占比较年初下降超16个百分点
items.summary: 韩国个人投资者交易占比从年初的48.11%降至7月的31.58%，7个月内大幅下降16.53个百分点。城堡证券预测到2028年，全球公开与私募信贷市场将为AI数据中心建设发行超5000亿美元债务，规模相当于彭博美国投资级债券指数总额的5%以上。

items.title: codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x
items.summary: codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x是一个GitHub仓库，汇集了从零开始重建各类技术的分步教程，涵盖3D渲染器、AI模型（LLM、扩散模型、RAG）、增强现实、BitTorrent客户端、区块链、操作系统、数据库、Docker、Web浏览器等数十个技术领域。
items.summary_en: codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x is a curated GitHub repository featuring step-by-step tutorials for recreating popular technologies from scratch, including AI models, blockchains, 3D renderers, game engines, and more. The project emphasizes hands-on learning through implementations in languages such as Python, Go, JavaScript, Rust, and C++, covering over 30 technology categories.

items.title: Show HN: Leclaude – A little badge for your Claude Code projects
items.summary_en: Leclaude is a free, MIT-licensed shell extension for Windows 10/11 (x64 and ARM64) that displays a robot badge on folders containing Claude Code session history. It registers a Windows Explorer icon-overlay handler that performs a fast in-memory set lookup against session data stored in %USERPROFILE%\.claude\projects\, with a watcher thread keeping badges updated. The tool builds with CMake/Ninja, offers installation via setup executable, zip file, or MSI (winget-compatible), and is signed with GitHub artifact attestation via Sigstore. Users should be aware that Windows limits overlay icons to 15, which may prevent the badge from displaying if other tools (like cloud sync apps) consume the slots.

items.title: From Agent Hallucinations to Token Economics: How 'Codeburn' and LSPs Are Solving the AI Coding Crisis
items.summary: Codeburn是一种新兴架构范式，通过结合Token经济学、静态分析和LSP（语言服务器协议）集成反馈循环，在代码生成阶段实时验证并丢弃无效token序列，从而消除Devin、Cursor、Copilot Workspace等AI编码代理的"幻觉"问题。与单纯增大上下文窗口（从4k到128k+ tokens）的现有
items.summary_en: AI coding agents like Devin, Cursor, and Copilot Workspace suffer from hallucinations—generating syntactically incorrect or logically flawed code—because LLMs operate on semantic patterns rather than the repository's actual AST. The emerging "Codeburn" architectural pattern addresses this by using the Language Server Protocol (LSP) and static analysis to constrain LLM generation in real time, discarding invalid token sequences before they're committed, thereby reducing token waste and context pollution. This shifts the burden of correctness from probabilistic models to deterministic feedback loops.

items.title: Why the Legendary Erdős Problems Are Falling to AI
items.summary: 2026年5月20日，OpenAI宣布其内部未发布AI模型给出了Erdős于1946年提出的"单位距离"问题的反例，这是首个来自AI的历史性重要证明。同年8月1日，OpenAI宣布未发布模型Astra在数学领域取得10项进展，包括解决了Erdős提出的3个问题，被许多数学家视为AI数学能力的"相变"。这一系列突破得益于数学家Thomas Bloom于2023年创建的erdosproblems.com问题数据库，他用ChatGPT编写了
items.summary_en: On May 20, 2026, OpenAI announced that an internal, non-public AI model produced a counterexample to Paul Erdős's 1946 "unit distance" problem — the first historically significant proof from an AI model. On August 1, 2026, OpenAI revealed that another unreleased model named Astra made 10 additional advances, including solving three more Erdős problems. The catalyst was mathematician Thomas Bloom, who launched erdosproblems.com in early 2023 (using ChatGPT to write the site's Python code) to catalog hundreds of Erdős's conjectures, which mathematicians now say represent a phase transition in AI's mathematical capabilities.

items.title: LLMs reward expertise
items.summary: 以数学家陶哲轩与ChatGPT探讨雅可比猜想（Jacobian Conjecture）反例为例，文章指出使用LLM的核心能力并非提示技巧，而是领域专业知识。具备领域知识的专家能够通过精准提问和有效引导，从GPT-5.6等模型中提取更高价值，避免泛泛的通用式交互。这意味着即使模型能力不断增强，人类专业知识仍是关键瓶颈——信息虽已存在于模型中，但需要懂行的专家才能将其有效引导出来。
items.summary_en: The article argues that domain expertise, not prompt-crafting技巧, is the most critical skill for getting high-quality results from LLMs, as demonstrated by Terence Tao's math conversation with ChatGPT. Experts can steer models effectively by recognizing errors, pushing back constructively, and asking specific questions rooted in deep knowledge. Rather than the model being the bottleneck, human expertise is — because extracting the right solution requires knowing what a good answer looks like in the first place.

items.title: Trump’s AI protectionism has come for robotics
items.summary_en: The FTC banned foreign imports of advanced robots, including humanoids and quadrupeds, citing national security concerns and the need to shield U.S. robotics from Chinese competition. However, the move risks backfiring: roughly 90% of U.S. university robotics research relies on Chinese Unitree robots, which cost about $4,600 for a four-legged model compared to $278,000 for a comparable Boston Dynamics robot. The ban is part of a broader Trump administration strategy to extend AI protectionism beyond leading labs into the emerging robotics sector.

items.title: After killer quarter, Palantir CEO Alex Karp calls AI industry ‘Marxist’
items.summary: Palantir CEO Alex Karp在季度股东信中批评AI前沿实验室过于不可信，称其意图"捕获生产资料"并带有"马克思主义色彩"。第二季度Palantir实现19亿美元收入（同比增93%）和11亿美元利润，创历史新高。Palantir提供模型无关的AI与分析软件，允许政府和企业的控制自身数据及AI"排放物"。
items.summary_en: Palantir reported a record-breaking second quarter with $1.9 billion in revenue, up 93% year-over-year, and $1.1 billion in profit. CEO Alex Karp used the shareholder letter to criticize AI frontier labs as untrustworthy for enterprises, accusing them of exploiting partnerships to capture clients' intellectual property and data while building competing products. Palantir positions itself as a model-agnostic alternative that gives organizations full control over their data and AI outputs.
